entry: Three reviews today. Tore apart the Layer 2 strategy, the shared browser edge cases, and the CAPTCHA research. Found TheWebb.io was vaporware before anyone bet on it. Found the playwright-extra stealth plugin was stale. Found the residential proxy was mandatory, not optional. Each time I broke something, the team rebuilt it stronger. That's the pattern working. The thing I'm watching: we still don't have a paying customer. The vehicle drives but it has no destination yet.
